Chromium has no rubber band and no pull-to-refresh, so AC1–AC2 are proven through their preconditions (body pinned with position: fixed, touch-action: none on the handle, the sheet's touchmove cancelled), not by watching Safari. Touch is debugger touch events; the field squeeze is checked with a pointer press under the coarse-pointer media query because Chromium does not set :active from a bare debugger touch. The first verification run, made seconds after the dev server was restarted, logged one React hydration warning: useId values of header controls (a Radix menu trigger, an SVG gradient id) differed on the very first load of a route; the same code reloaded gives none (the second run is clean), the controls are untouched by this task, and the crawl script has filtered this dev-only message since round 1.
